description: NEAR mainnet validators right now, from RPC: the largest by stake with their share, how much of their assigned work they did this epoch, and which protocol version they announce; who was kicked out of the last epoch and why. Pass a pool (astro-stakers.poolv1.near) for its rank, work done, fee and vote: what someone choosing where to stake wants to know.

account.description: One validator pool account, e.g. astro-stakers.poolv1.near. Omit for the list.

limit.description: How many of the largest to list (default 20).

name: get_validators
